blind.B1: No exercise arm. The only physical-activity manipulation is 3 weeks of hindlimb unloading (disuse; S2.2, S5), with 4-PBA as a drug arm. Whether HU counts as an exercise-question series is an open policy question; if analyzed, HU vs GC is the inactivity side. All 9 sequenced kidneys (3 GC, 3 HU, 3 HU-t) carry the unloading factor; none carry exercise.
blind.B2: HU vs GC, HU-t vs HU, HU-t vs GC (Fig. 4a-c, S3.3.p1); 3 sequenced kidneys per group (S2.4; animal study n=10/group per Fig. 2).
blind.B3: None: one kidney per mouse, independent animals. Title suffix (1-3) pairs samples across groups but is only a within-group replicate index.
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint vs pairwise; only 'analyzed using DESeq2' (S2.8.p1).
blind.B5: S2.8.p1: 'Genes with an adjusted p < 0.05 were assigned as significantly differentially expressed genes' (BH FDR; the 'log2Fold change > 0' clause only splits direction, no magnitude cutoff). Counts S3.3.p1: control vs HU 6628 (4592 up/2036 down); HU-t vs HU 3543 (1096/2447); HU-t vs GC 1114 (890/224); total 11285.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm; HU analyzed as inactivity estimand and labelled 'not an exercise effect' in caveats and HANDBACK. Policy question open (disuse series).
GC/HU/HUt 3/3/3 matches S2.4; exact alignment 9/9; control for HU is GC, for HUt is HU, as in Fig. 4.
Contrasts ordered treatment vs control (HU vs GC, HUt vs HU, HUt vs GC) as Fig. 4 legend; paper text 'control vs HU' ambiguity noted in caveats.
One kidney per mouse; title suffix is a replicate index, pairing_check not_supported (r diff 0.048, p=0.34).
Paper silent on joint vs pairwise; joint limma ~grp recorded. Open policy item.
All male, single tissue; no batch info in GEO; recorded.
Only FPKM deposited; limma on log2(FPKM+1) with FPKM>=1 in >=3 filter declared as deviation from DESeq2 on counts.
padj<0.05, no fold-change cutoff, transcribed exactly from S2.8.p1; audit |lfc|>1 labelled audit only. No alternative rule reproduces paper counts (packet B table).
Same three contrasts compared; large gaps (1277 vs 6628, 361 vs 3543, 0 vs 1114) stated as not matching, with deviation reasons; ER-stress claim recorded as not reproduced.

human_items: Whether a hindlimb-unloading (disuse) series counts as an exercise study at all.
Joint vs pairwise fit when the paper is silent; counts differ greatly from paper (n=3/group, FPKM instead of counts).
summary: 该系列没有运动组，只有后肢卸载（废用）与4-PBA药物组；分析将其明确标注为“不活动”方向而非运动效应，分组、方向、阈值（padj<0.05，无FC截断）均与论文一致。因只有FPKM，改用limma并声明偏离，DEG数与论文差距大但已如实记录。无阻断或主要问题，仅有待人工决定的政策问题。
